Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows hypoxemia, mild anemia, leukopenia with neutropenia, thrombocytopenia, and elevated ferritin, creatinine, chloride, INR, monocytes, and basophils. Inflammatory markers (CRP, D-dimer) are at the upper limit of normal. These findings may indicate acute or chronic inflammation, possible infection, and impaired renal function. Clinical correlation and further investigation are recommended.
